verdict.rationale: Greenhouse has a dedicated webhooks documentation page with an event catalog covering events such as Application created, Application deleted, Candidate hired and Candidate merged, so subscribing to recruiting events via webhooks is supported. The evidence is a single excerpt listing event names and says nothing about how subscriptions work. Missing for 10: details on subscription setup and configuration, payload signing/verification, retry and delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
